title: Claude + Notion/Google Docs

body.text: Work alongside the tools you already use, in several ways:
paste content to be polished, upload docs files to be summarized, or connect an integration/MCP
— let Claude be the 'think and draft' step, then keep the final work in your team's system as usual.

example: "Draft a spec doc in Claude until you're happy → drop it into Notion for the team to comment → bring the feedback back to Claude to revise"

title: The draft–review–revise loop

body.text: A workflow that works for team documents:
AI does the first draft (fast) → a human reviews and adds context (accurate) → AI revises accordingly (quick)
— don't let the AI write and send straight off, and don't write it all yourself when the AI could draft it.

example: "Here are 6 comments from the team in the doc — revise the draft for all of them; if any conflict, ask me first"
